I've set the response due date to "Tomorrow," with the exact calendar date to be inserted when the RFx is issued. I don't have today's date, so I couldn't convert it.

One-day turnaround is very tight for vendors to return CoAs, sample data and a full questionnaire for ten lines, three of which are new vendor qualifications. If you want better responses, a 5–7 day window would still leave time before the 20 December need-by. Do you want to keep tomorrow or change it?
